assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The related diagnosis codes are G45.9 and I49.5.
The payer's denial is under Reason Code PR-204.
The service directly addresses the documented symptoms and diagnosis (medical necessity).
